description: This file contains a test script for adding, verifying, and removing an iptables rate limit rule with counters and specific matching conditions. It automates iptables commands to manage firewall rules related to ICMP echo-request packets, verifies rule presence and counters, and cleans up by removing the rule.

methods.name: add_rate_limit_rule
methods.description: Inserts a rate limiting rule into the iptables INPUT chain for ICMP echo-request packets.

methods.name: verify_rule_presence
methods.description: Verifies the presence of the inserted rule by parsing iptables rules.

methods.name: check_counters
methods.description: Displays the counters for the rule to verify the number of matches.

methods.name: remove_rate_limit_rule
methods.description: Removes the previously added rate limit rule from the iptables INPUT chain.
